# AwardGrid

> AwardGrid is an iPhone app by Curastone CORP. It puts seats.aero's cached award availability for several origins, several destinations and up to 92 days into one table. Your own seats.aero data (optional): if you have a seats.aero account with API access (part of seats.aero Pro, which AwardGrid does not sell), you can connect it to see results from that account instead of sample data.

## Facts (checked 2026-10-08)

- Price and status: AwardGrid for iPhone has been submitted as a free app, with no in-app purchase. Your own seats.aero data (optional): if you have a seats.aero account with API access (part of seats.aero Pro, which AwardGrid does not sell), you can connect it to see results from that account instead of sample data. AwardGrid for iPhone is submitted to the App Store and not available there yet.
- Sample data: Without a seats.aero account, AwardGrid shows sample data only: search, the List, Calendar and Matrix views, option details, compare, Saved and Watches all work on sample data made on the iPhone, for any route between the 84 airports it recognises, over the next 12 months. Sample data is labelled on every screen that shows it, its options have no booking links, and nothing is sent.
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 18 or later. The app's interface is in English or Simplified Chinese.
- Input: Type the routes and dates in English or Chinese, or set them in the editor.
- Table: Each cell shows the lowest miles for each cabin you asked for, with the program and the seats left; each option also shows its fees and how old the data is.
- Views: List, Calendar and Matrix views; compare up to four options; save results on the device.
- Data: Results are seats.aero's cached availability, not a live search, and each shows how old it is. It covers the 26 programs seats.aero lists, where seats.aero monitors the route. An empty result means seats.aero has no cached availability for that route and day, which can also mean seats.aero does not monitor the route.
- Watches: Watches are checked when you open or return to the app, and at no other time; there is no background check and no notification.
- Trip planner: Plan a trip shows how AwardGrid reads a trip you type, as airports, dates and cabins, without an account and without sending anything. A plan can be saved on the device, in Saved › Trip plans, and tried on sample data.
- Ask: Ask, which answers questions about your results with Claude on your own Anthropic API key, is in testing; it is not part of the App Store version 1.0. Search needs no AI key.
- Connecting: You connect your seats.aero account with seats.aero's own sign-in (Login with Seats.aero): seats.aero asks you to sign in and approve AwardGrid, and AwardGrid never sees your password. You can disconnect at any time, in AwardGrid or in your seats.aero settings.
- Privacy: The AwardGrid iPhone app has no accounts of its own, and there is no analytics, advertising, tracking or crash reporting in the app. Searches on your own seats.aero account go from the iPhone directly to seats.aero, and a small token service at awardgrid.dowhiz.com exchanges and refreshes the sign-in tokens and stores nothing; sample data sends nothing.
- Short-term caching: Results from your seats.aero account are kept on the iPhone for at most 24 hours (seats.aero's Short-Term Caching rule); a saved search keeps the search and a summary, and opening it searches again.
- Availability: AwardGrid for iPhone will be offered in 174 countries or regions; not in mainland China.
- Dependency: AwardGrid depends on seats.aero's Partner API and connects to your seats.aero account through seats.aero's own sign-in (Login with Seats.aero); seats.aero's terms apply to that account.

## What the app does not do

No live search, no booking, no round trips, no alerts or notifications, no scraping of airline or bank sites, no airline or bank passwords, no logos. Searches are one-way: no round trips, multi-city or passenger count.

## Name

AwardGrid (one word, capital G) is this iPhone app. The web app at awardgrid.dowhiz.com is private and invite-only; it is separate from the iPhone app. The domain awardgrid.com is not owned by Curastone CORP.

## Relationship

AwardGrid is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by seats.aero, Anthropic, any airline, or any loyalty program. Its data comes from seats.aero (https://seats.aero).
